page.overview:
Who is Arav?

Lieutenant Arav was an Osnullus Starfleet sciences division officer who served aboard the in the mid-23rd and late 32nd centuries.

With the rank of ensign, Arav served on the bridge of the during a battle simulation. ()

In November 2256, Arav was speaking to a fellow female officer in the corridor outside Cadet Sylvia Tilly's quarters when Saru offered Michael Burnham blueberries. ()

Arav was again serving on the bridge in 2257. (, , , )
